notes.title: Have You Played Majesty?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

I didn’t love Majesty [official site] as much as I loved the concept of Majesty, which is probably why I’ve been waiting for a(nother) sequel for so long. A new version, done properly, could well be one of my favourite games. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available - Defenders of Ardania
notes.notes:
Defenders of Ardania is now available on Steam!

Defenders of Ardania is a next-generation tower defense game set in the rich fantasy world of Majesty, but with a twist. In addition to the addictive core mechanics of placing towers to stop advancing enemy units, DoA also allows players to take on the role of the attackers seeking to conquer the enemy base in both single and multiplayer combat!

To celebrate the launch of Defenders of Ardania, the Majesty 2 series is on sale at 75% off until Thursday, March 15th at 10AM Pacific time!

notes.title: Beastly: Majesty 2 Monster Kingdom
notes.notes:
Indirect-RTS (IndirTS, as it must now officially be known) Majesty 2 is gearing up for its 300019th and final expansion pack, Monster Kingdom, and it’s the most enticing yet. By which I mean “most like Dungeon Keeper, a game I’ve been geeking out over for more than a decade.”

notes.title: Majesty 2: Battles Of Ardania Goes Gold
notes.notes:
The second expansion for fantasy village bribery sim Majesty 2, Battles of Ardania, is out now. Ardania adds a new 8 mission campaign, 4 new multiplayer maps, a sprinkling of new weapons and a couple of glugs of new monsters. I sat down with Alec, RPS’s resident Majesty 2 veteran, to ask him how he felt about this expansion. Not that he’s actually played it or anything.
(more…)

notes.title: Really Scrape The Sky: Majesty 2: Kingmaker
notes.notes:
I ended up not actually playing any more of Majesty 2 after its pre-release code, but Alec didn’t find its city-management totally revolting. Or at least it didn’t increase the amount of dark woe in his black heart more than was there before he started playing, leading him to descend into his special dank pit, to carve gargoyles of all those who raise his ire. Which translates to “Quite Good” or “7/10, probably” in most people’s scales. Anyway, its expansion is out now. Its top-level features are a new campaign, a randomise feature to add to a mission’s replayability and more mod support. Full details and purchase options on its site and the launch trailer can be found below. Any big Majesty 2 fans in the house? By which I mean, website comments thread.
